caseName: McKinney v. Missouri - Kansas - Texas Railroad
caseNameFull: McKinney v. Missouri - Kansas - Texas Railroad Co.
attorneys: Solicitor General Rankin for petitioner. Sam Elson was on the motion for the Brotherhood of Railway Clerks, respondent.

opinions.text: Certiorari, 353 U. S. 948, to the United States Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. The motion to remove this case from the summary calendar is granted and a total of one hour and a half allowed for oral argument.
